plugins.name: xestando
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to Xestando, the Spanish business suite for VERI*FACTU invoicing, expenses, quotes, contacts, files and company knowledge. Every write is a proposal: the hosted MCP creates a pending task, you approve it in the Xestando app, and Prompt Shield keeps tax IDs, emails and IBANs out of the model.

skills.name: xestando
skills.description: Use when working with the user's business data in Xestando — creating invoices, expenses, quotes, contacts, calendar events, email or LinkedIn posts, templates, generating reports, searching company knowledge, or reading clients, providers, employees and stored files through the Xestando MCP tools. Explains the approve-in-app flow that every write goes through.
